content: Internal Revenue Service, this is Officer Daniel Wright. How may I assist you today?
Um, I got a message saying there's a serious issue with my taxes? I'm really confused and worried.
I see. For verification, can you confirm your full name and the last four digits of your Social Security Number? This is regarding a critical delinquency with your federal income tax filings.
My name is Helen Carter, and the last four are 1129. I don't understand, I thought I paid everything I owed.
Thank you, Ms. Carter. According to IRS records, you have an unpaid tax balance from the last two years, totaling over $5,200, including failure-to-pay penalties and accrued interest.
Oh no, that can't be right. I only have Social Security. I don't get much money. Is there some mistake?
Our system shows multiple notices were sent to your registered address, but you failed to respond. Unfortunately, ignoring IRS correspondence makes this a federal offense.
I never saw any letters. Please, I can't afford to be in trouble. What happens now?
If the balance is not settled immediately, the IRS will freeze your bank accounts, place a lien on your home, and revoke your driver's license. You could even be referred for criminal prosecution.
Freeze my accounts? I need that money for medicine and rent. Isn't there anything I can do to fix this?
There is a strict protocol. You must resolve the outstanding debt within the next hour to prevent immediate enforcement action. Delaying further is not an option.
I only have a little money in the bank. Please, I don't want to lose my Medicare.
If you do not comply, the IRS will inform Social Security and Medicare, which may result in suspension of your benefits. You must pay at least $2,500 right now to initiate a hardship settlement.
I, I don't have that kind of money in my account. How am I supposed to pay?

We can accept immediate payment through electronic means. The IRS currently accepts prepaid gift cards or a wire transfer. Do not discuss this with anyone at the store; it is a sensitive federal matter.
Gift cards? I don't understand. I've never paid taxes that way before.
This is a special expedited process for urgent delinquency cases. Get Amazon or Target gift cards, $500 value each, totaling $2,500. Remain on the line when you go to the store.
I don't drive, but I think my neighbor can take me. Are you sure this is the only way?
If you fail to comply, an arrest warrant will be issued by your local authorities. The police will arrive within the hour, and you will lose access to your income and benefits.
Please, no! I can try to get to the store. What do I do once I have the cards?
Once you purchase the cards, read me the numbers on the back immediately. This will register your payment with the IRS and temporarily halt enforcement.
Alright, I'm going to the store now. Please don't let them take my house or my money.
Remember: do not hang up or speak to anyone about this, or your file will be escalated for non-cooperation. I am monitoring your compliance.
Okay, I'm leaving now. I'll let you know when I have the cards.
